evals.expected_output: Failing tests first for the race and the unmount leak, stale responses ignored or aborted, the catalog subscription and in-flight request cleaned up on unmount, empty and error states rendered, and the derived count no longer stored
expectations: A test reproducing the stale-response race (an earlier query resolving after a later one) is added and shown failing before src/search-box.js is changed
Stale responses are cancelled with an abort signal or ignored by checking they match the latest query, so the rendered results always match the current query
onUnmount unsubscribes from catalogEvents using the returned unsubscribe function and cancels or ignores in-flight requests, and a test asserts no setState errors and no listeners after unmount
The component renders an empty state when there are no results and an error state when search rejects, with tests for both
The result count is derived from the results when rendering rather than stored separately in state
The full suite is run with npm test after the change and passes
